school.name: International Community High School
school.overview: We are a community of English Language Learners from all parts of the world, learning and working together in teams. Our school and classes are small. Students receive personal attention from teachers and school staff. We have 1 counselor available per 100 students. Students work collaboratively in small groups to learn English in every subject. Students are given a college preparatory experience, with internship opportunities in preparation for life after high school. We are part of the Internationals Network for Public Schools with over 30 years of successful experience working with recent immigrant teens and their families.
school.subway: 2, 5 to 149th St-3rd Av; 6 to Brook Av
school.bus: Bx1, Bx15, Bx17, Bx19, Bx2, Bx21, Bx32, Bx33, Bx4, Bx41, Bx41-SBS, M125

programs.name: International Community High School (Y23A)
programs.eligibility: Open only to New York City residents living in the continental United States four years or fewer who currently identify as English Language Learners per New York City Department of Education guidelines scoring at the Entering, Emerging, or Transitioning levels on the NYSESLAT, NYSITELL, or LAB-R.
programs.description: Each new student and family attends a comprehensive orientation session during the last week of August.
